description: This file contains unit tests for the SchemaOnlyTuner class in the org.openmrs.liquibase package. It tests functionality such as reading, modifying, and processing Liquibase changelog XML files related to schema management.

classes.name: SchemaOnlyTunerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for SchemaOnlyTuner, testing XML parsing and modification methods.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test environment, reads sample changelog XML, and sets up namespace mappings.

methods.name: shouldCreateUpdatedChangeLogFile
methods.description: Tests creation of an updated changelog file and comparison with an expected XML.

methods.name: shouldDetachChangeSetsForLiquibaseTables
methods.description: Tests that specific Liquibase tables are removed from the changelog XML.

methods.name: shouldReplaceBitTypeWithBooleanType
methods.description: Verifies replacement of BIT data types with BOOLEAN in the XML.

methods.name: shouldReplaceLongtextTypeWithClobType
methods.description: Verifies replacement of LONGTEXT data types with CLOB in the XML.

methods.name: shouldAssertLongtextNode
methods.description: Checks that the assertion for correct LONGTEXT node structure passes.

methods.name: shouldDetectWrongNumberOfLongtextNodes
methods.description: Ensures an assertion error is thrown if the number of LONGTEXT nodes is incorrect.

methods.name: shouldDetectWrongGrandParentNodeOfLongtextNode
methods.description: Ensures an assertion error is thrown if LONGTEXT nodes are not nested correctly.
